description: This file defines the CriteriaVisitor interface, which specifies methods for visiting various criteria expressions used in querying logic within the Eclipse Ditto project. It primarily contains method signatures for processing different types of logical operations (AND, OR, NOR, EXISTS, etc.) on criteria components.

classes.name: CriteriaVisitor
classes.description: Interface for implementing visitors that process query criteria objects with methods for logical operations and specific criterion handling.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Process a list of criteria applying AND semantics.

methods.name: visitAnd (default method)
methods.description: Default implementation that collects a stream of criteria into a list and calls the primary visitAnd method.

methods.name: visitAny
methods.description: Process a criteria that matches any condition.

methods.name: visitExists
methods.description: Process an ExistsFieldExpression to check for field existence.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Process a FilterFieldExpression with a predicate for filtering conditions.

methods.name: visitNor
methods.description: Process negated disjuncts applying NOR semantics.

methods.name: visitNor (default method)
methods.description: Default implementation that collects a stream into a list and calls the primary visitNor method.

methods.name: visitOr (default method)
methods.description: Default implementation that collects a stream into a list and calls the primary visitOr method.
